fact: On 14 February 2024 the Ministry of Industry and the OCC signed a protocol mandating the OCC, a public establishment, to assess conformity to Congolese NCD standards and apply the national conformity mark, with a National Standardisation Committee (CNN) seized on adopting regional or international standards.
title: Protocole d'accord de collaboration entre le Ministère de l'Industrie et l'Office Congolais de Contrôle
